title: lamium orientale
intro: Lamium orientale, commonly known as Syrian mint, is a species of flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Syrian mint, such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The plant's leaves and flowers can be used in herbal remedies to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, colds, and coughs.
